subject: Streaming sessions drop after 60 seconds
body: Every streamed tour disconnects after exactly 60 seconds for all users since last night. We tried Chrome, Edge and Safari on two different networks.

subject: Map pins misplaced on iPhone
body: On iPhone the nearby-amenities map pins are offset by about 200 metres. Android and desktop are correct.

subject: Tooltip text overflows
body: On small laptop screens the unit tooltip text spills outside its box when the unit name is long.

subject: Enquiry form stuck on Safari
body: Buyers on Safari get a spinner forever when they submit the enquiry form, so we're losing leads. Chrome works fine.

subject: API rate limit lower than documented
body: Your docs say 600 requests per minute but we get a 429 after about 100. Our nightly inventory sync now fails halfway.

subject: Test cases for payment-plan calculator
body: The payment-plan calculator is signed off. QA, please write the test cases and add them to the automation suite before it ships next sprint.

subject: Update visual regression baselines
body: The visual regression tests flag every page since the font change. Please update the screenshot baselines.

subject: Please reproduce duplicate-units bug
body: A client reports duplicated units in search but the developers can't reproduce it. QA, can you try to reproduce it on their data set and document the exact steps?

subject: Smoke test blocking merges
body: Merges to main are blocked because the 'login as agent' smoke test fails on the CI runner. Please look into the test.

subject: Share tour on WhatsApp
body: A share-to-WhatsApp button inside the tour would be super useful for our agents!

subject: Dark theme for the dashboard
body: Our team often works late; a dark theme for the admin dashboard would be welcome.

subject: Price history per unit
body: Several investors have asked to see the price history of each unit. Could this be considered for the roadmap?

subject: Why was 'save tour' removed?
body: The latest update removed the 'save tour' button and our agents relied on it every day. Was this intentional?

subject: Renewal pricing
body: Our annual contract ends next month. Can we discuss renewal pricing for 15 projects?

subject: PO number on invoice
body: Our finance team needs PO number 88341 added to the October invoice before they can pay it.

subject: BILLED AGAIN FOR CANCELLED PROJECTS
body: You billed us AGAIN for two projects we cancelled in August. If this isn't fixed today we will file a chargeback.

subject: Partner pricing for agencies
body: We're an agency working with five developers. Do you offer partner pricing?

subject: Change logo in tours
body: How can we change the logo shown in the top corner of our tours?

subject: Reset link always expired
body: Every password reset link I get says 'expired', even when I click it straight away. I've tried three times.

subject: Training for new agents
body: Thanks for the great onboarding! Could we book a short training session for four new sales agents?
